expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promotional banner text has very low contrast: white text is placed on a very pale mint background, making the heading and subtitle hard to read.
The bottom navigation appears to overlap the restaurant content. The lower popular item is partially hidden behind the fixed tab bar, which makes the card feel cut off.
A partial empty category pill is visible on the far right of the category row, which looks like a broken or blank filter chip.

Horizontal restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section are heavily cropped at the right edge, including the restaurant name, which may look visually broken if not clearly intended as a carousel.
